body.zh: pH 用对数刻度表示氢离子浓度：每差 1，浓度差 10 倍。pH 7 附近为中性，越小越酸，越大越碱。本实验台用稀溶液浓度近似（强酸强碱模型），不讨论活度与弱酸平衡。
body.en: pH is a logarithmic scale of hydrogen-ion concentration: one unit means a tenfold change. Near 7 is neutral; lower is acidic, higher basic. This lab uses the dilute strong-acid/strong-base approximation, no activity or weak-acid equilibria.
